kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتقهقر (form IIq)
# أَتَقَهْقَرُ (ʔataqahqaru) /ʔa.ta.qah.qa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
# أَتَقَهْقَرَ (ʔataqahqara) /ʔa.ta.qah.qa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
# أَتَقَهْقَرْ (ʔataqahqar) /ʔa.ta.qah.qar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَقَهْقَرَ (taqahqara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
